notes: UCSD major code AT25. Total ~108 units (56 lower-division + 52 upper-division). C- or better in every course applied to the major; 2.0 GPA in upper-division major courses; at least 60% of upper-division major courses in residence at UCSD. Verified against catalog.ucsd.edu/curric/ASTR-ug.html and astro.ucsd.edu majors-minor page. Note: the catalog states lower-division physics as 'PHYS 4A-B-C-D-E or PHYS 2A-B-C-D and ASTR 18' for THIS major (ASTR 18 is explicitly required alongside the PHYS 2 track, whereas it is only recommended for the Astrophysical Sciences major). ASTR 199/199H honors thesis (4 units) may count as one upper-division ASTR elective.

buckets.label: Introductory Physics sequence
buckets.note: Complete EITHER the full PHYS 2A-B-C-D sequence (4 courses) OR the full PHYS 4A-B-C-D-E sequence (5 courses). needed=4 reflects the shorter PHYS 2 track; the PHYS 4 track requires all five. For THIS major, students on the PHYS 2 track must also take ASTR 18 (required, not merely recommended). Not a free choice of 4 from the pooled list.
